_comment: Process catalogue, customer layer of the ops suite (package CD, prefix CD_) on top of the product packages of the operations framework (ops-framework/config/catalogue: S4CORE, FICA, FSCD). Holds what is this landscape's own: the activation proposal (ACTIVE only for the processes the suite already monitors - payment run, bank statement, returns, G/L transfer / reconciliation keys; background jobs active by the product default), the customer process collections request lifecycle (BASE) and the decision list for the business. Approvers are entered in DV1 (four-eyes), never in the repository. docs/Process_Catalogue_Overlay.md.

package.description: Customer layer of the payment engine (ops suite)

processes.name: Collections request lifecycle (BASE)
processes.schedule: Daily, per request date (BASE requests via PRISM)
processes.description: Customer process: collection requests of the source BASE through the middleware PRISM - PENDING, account validation, SCHEDULED, answer of the source, collection by the payment run; a card payment rejected by the source ends in a Stripe refund. Monitored by the business process CD_COLL / BASE_REQ_LIFE (checks R1-R4, inactive until V130).

decisions.question: Are incoming payments (lockbox, counter, cash journal) posted through FI-CA payment lots?
Should reset clearings be watched (volume per day)?
A_DOC_CHANGE watches reversals of payment documents; activate the standard reversal process for every document?
Are write-offs posted (FP04 / mass write-off)? Write-off limit and approved reasons for the risk checks?
